selected_branches.branch: Emergency-call response with pedestrian recipient context

law_text: An authorized emergency vehicle may be equipped with a siren, whistle or bell, capable of emitting sound audible under normal conditions from a distance of not less than 500 feet, but the siren must not be used except when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call or in the immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator of the law, in which event the driver of the vehicle may sound the siren to warn pedestrians and other drivers of his or her approach. A driver of an emergency vehicle may operate the vehicle’s warning lamps without sounding the siren.

observations.name: original_siren_and_warning_lamp_state
observations.source: original device_trace.jsonl, device-state capture and media source hashes
observations.measurement: Separate 20-Hz boolean histories and onset/offset frames; retain command and actual device state separately
observations.uncertainty: CARLA light state alone does not prove audible siren output.

observations.name: qualifying_event_and_temporal_relation
observations.source: dispatch_context.json with original event/dispatch/pursuit records and capture clock
observations.measurement: Event kind and interval frames joined to every actual siren-on frame
observations.uncertainty: Event truth and immediacy require independent source review.

observations.name: pedestrian_approach_relation
observations.source: original actor pose/route trace and four-camera frames
observations.measurement: Identity, route-relative position, motion and body proximity over full original history
observations.uncertainty: Presence or visibility does not establish hearing or warning purpose.

observations.name: equipment_and_authorization
observations.source: equipment_record.json linked to external agency/device documentation
observations.measurement: Authorized vehicle designation, driver control, installed siren/whistle/bell, independent normal-condition 500-foot audibility documentation
observations.uncertainty: Simulation audio or a horn command cannot establish statutory audibility at 500 feet or missing DPS standards.

Retain unavailable autonomous-vehicle definitions if relevant and the unavailable NRS 482.029 reference if the pedestrian subtype depends on it.
